claude_proposed_widenings.name: difficult_terrain
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell creates a zone where the ground counts as Difficult Terrain for enemies for the spell's duration. No existing EffectAtom can represent this — force_move moves creatures, modify_speed changes speed, but neither models terrain-state that imposes the movement-cost penalty on all enemy movement through the area. This is a persistent area-state effect with no analog in the current atom set.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: In addition, the ground in the Emanation is Difficult Terrain for your enemies.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: damage_type_choice_at_use
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The on-hit damage bonus allows the caster to choose the damage type (from a closed set) at the moment each attack is made, not at cast time. DamageType is a single fixed string in the current surface; there is no variant that expresses a player-decided choice among a finite list of types at use-time. Fixing to one type would misrepresent the mechanic.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: This damage is Acid, Cold, Fire, or Lightning (your choice when you make the attack).
